nodes.rationale: Approval locks lot and posts receipt once; lot correction must not create new receipts; cancellation does not delete Booking Fee receipt.

nodes.label: Anti-AI-slop design rules
nodes.rationale: Every design decision must have a clear purpose; avoid generic dashboards, gradients, glassmorphism, repetitive cards, arbitrary colors, decorative motion. Applies to src/**/*.{vue,css,scss,sass,ts,tsx,js,jsx}.

nodes.label: React reference boundary
nodes.rationale: React skills are conceptual references only; translate principles into Vue 3 components, composables, props, emits, slots, provide/inject.

nodes.label: Vue 3 + Ionic skill compatibility constraints
nodes.rationale: Reuse existing Ionic components, architecture, API services, Supabase services and Capacitor behavior; prefer <script setup> Composition API.

nodes.rationale: Wraps ion-button; variant API takes priority over legacy color; loading sets aria-busy and blocks double clicks.

nodes.label: AppModal
